notes.title: A Message from the LoveStartsAgain Team - September 11, 2025
notes.content: [p]We would like to express our heartfelt gratitude for all the warm and thoughtful feedback we have received for Love: Start Again.[/p][p]Since the game's launch, it has been a great joy and a huge encouragement for our entire team to see so many players sharing their experiences and impressions on Steam and various social media platforms.[/p][p]While we cherish each and every one of your voices, we recognize that there are still areas for improvement due to production schedules and other factors. Please know that we are taking all of your feedback seriously and are committed to delivering even higher-quality content through future updates. It is our sincere hope that Love: Start Again will be more than just a romance adventure game, but an experience that brings a sense of healing and warmth to all who play.[/p][p]Moving forward, our team will continue to value your feedback as we work to optimize every detail. Our goal is to ensure that the romance unfolding in Tokyo becomes a deeply empathetic and resonant story for you.[/p][p]Once again, we thank you from the bottom of our hearts for your understanding and support. We look forward to your continued cooperation. Please, continue to enjoy the game![/p][p]Sincerely,[/p][p]The Love: Start Again Project Team[/p][p]September 2025[/p]

notes.title: Announcing our new "Streaming Guidelines" and "Contact" Page!
notes.content:
[p]In response to the many requests we have received from our community on social media, we are pleased to announce that we have officially established our "Streaming Guidelines." Our goal with these guidelines is to create an environment where all players can feel safe and confident sharing their gameplay experiences with a wider audience.
[/p][p]We kindly ask that you take a moment to review them.
We hope you continue to enjoy Love: Start Again![/p][p]Click here for the "[url="https://lovestartsagain.jp/?p=115"]Streaming Guidelines[/url]"[/p]

notes.title: The FMV Romance Game Love: Start Again is Now Available!
notes.content: [p]This title is an interactive, live-action romance adventure based on the concepts of "Real-Life Video" x "Time Leap" x "Romance" x "Gaming." You'll experience a story that unfolds through immersive, first-person videos, similar to a short drama, where your choices shape the future. The story follows a protagonist who, after collapsing from overwork at a soul-crushing corporation, time-leaps back to his college days to fight for a brighter future.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45622303/5c9a2c8e6c8123f94e3859885b51226606602614.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]In addition to classic romance archetypes like the charming junior, the reliable senior, and the childhood friend, the game also offers a modern twist: the chance to romance your favorite influencer. After the time leap, you'll be swept up in the kind of dramatic romance you've always dreamed of, with dates unfolding at various real-life locations across Tokyo.[/p][p]We are committed to enhancing the player experience with future updates. If you enjoy your journey, we would greatly appreciate it if you could leave a review![/p][p]With a total video volume equivalent to two feature films, this is a truly ambitious and lovingly crafted project. Don't miss this opportunity to get your hands on Love: Start Again, the live-action romance adventure from Japan that's already gaining attention on social media worldwide![/p]
